name: SmartDrive inc.
summary: SmartDrive inc. creates data-driven platforms and services to advance mobility in Japan. SmartDrive Fleet is a cloud-hosted vehicle management system helping companies with fleets in areas such as driver safety, legal compliance and alcohol check records. It also provides a Mobility Data Platform processing sensor-derived data, plus telematics services and data collection and analysis. Dating from 2013, it has its headquarters in Chiyoda, Japan.
